review_description: Thank you Finn for your most informative information. It made the whole experience a lot easier. Only one of your people (the one in south Perth ) got in touch to give me a quote. Kaejen services gave me a very good quote and had the system in with in two weeks. They arrived on time (2 electricians and 2 apprentices)and had the system installed in 3 hours. They are accredited installers and did all the paper work and explained the workings to me. Once again thank you for your help.
Even in the cloudy and rainy weather we have lately, we are still exporting sufficient kwh to cover all our electricity costs.
